title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-i98v: vectors.rs contains duplicate function definitions from incomplete code replacement
description:
Commit 9c95a86902 attempted to replace old test code in vectors.rs (old context_at using load_existing, old test_request_protection_vectors reading expected values from JSON, old test_response_protection_vectors using protect_response) with new code (new context_at using new()+restore_existing(), hardcoded independent oracle test vectors, unprotect_response). However, the replacement was not performed — instead, new code was appended after old code, leaving duplicate definitions:

- context_at at lines 105 and 126
- test_request_protection_vectors at lines 175 and 430
- test_response_protection_vectors at lines 225 and 492

Additionally:
- Expected struct still has oscore_option and ciphertext fields (lines 100-101) that the new code no longer uses, conflicting with new Expected at line 97
- Vector struct still has include_piv field (line 73)
- Old code references removed API (load_existing, ctx.protect_request() direct)

Result: cargo check --test vectors -p lichen-oscore fails with 14 errors including E0428 duplicate definitions, E0599 missing API, E0061 wrong argument count, E0382 borrow after move.

The pre-existing broken test code in lib.rs (load_existing calls that never existed, protect_response with wrong arg count) is not caused by this commit but should be addressed separately.

Fix: Remove old code (lines approximately 1-425) and keep only the new replacement code. Also update Expected struct to match.
